title: SPA/385/2015 of Kashmir Singh up Pradhan Vs Smt Tabassum AND OTHERS

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Special Appeal No. 385 of 2015
With
(Delay Condonation Application No. 8744 of 2015)
(Application for Leave to Appeal No. 8745 of 2015)
 Kashmir Singh (Up Pradhan) ......... Appellant

Versus
Smt. Tabassum and others ......... Respondents
Present: Mr. Arvind Kumar Sharma, Advocate for the appellant.
 Mr. Lok Pal Singh, Advocate for respondent No.1.
 Mr. H. M.Bhatia, Brief Holder for the State/respondent Nos. 2
 & 3.

Coram : Hon'ble K.M. Joseph, C.J.
 Hon'ble V.K. Bist, J.
JUDGMENT
Date: 10th August, 2015
K.M. Joseph, C.J. (Oral)

Learned counsel for the appellant seeks permission to
withdraw the application for condonation of delay, application for
leave to appeal and the appeal with liberty to move the learned
Single Judge for impleadment in the writ petition and for filing stay
vacation application also.
 Permission granted.
 All these aforesaid applications and the appeal are
dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to move the learned Single
Judge for impleadment and also for filing application for vacation
of the interim order which is impugned in the appeal.

(V.K. Bist, J.) (K.M. Joseph, C.J.)
 10.08.2015 10.08.2015
P. Singh
